business_summary: Acrobiosystems Co.,Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of recombinant proteins, antibodies, and other biological reagents for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, and research institutions. It provides kits, scientific services, and other related products under the Resilient Supply, CytoPak, SAFENSURE, FLAG, Star Staining, Aneuro, ComboX, and GENPower brands. The company also offers cell therapies, gene therapies, therapeutic antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, core reagents for infectious disease research, and solutions for metabolic and autoimmune disease drug development. In addition, it provides custom reagent, assay development, and analytical services. Further, the company is involved in general business, sales and technical services of biological products, manufacture and sells medical devices, research and development of biological reagent products, business information consulting and conference, and company testing service businesses. The company's products are used in drug screening and optimization for diseases such as cancer, autoimmune diseases, cardiovascular diseases, and infectious diseases; diagnostic reagent development and optimization; preclinical and clinical trials; and drug manufacturing processes and process control. Acrobiosystems Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Beijing, China.
